body.interpretation: Rows 0 and 2 contain four DOWN/front frames followed by four UP/back frames. Row 1 is the eight-frame RIGHT walk. Row 3 is the eight-frame LEFT walk.

combat.interpretation: These are isolated arms plus paintball-marker artwork, eight poses per row. They are NOT sixteen unique aim sectors: barrel directions visibly repeat within each row, and the frames do not form a monotonic angular sequence.
combat.reason: The artwork supplies isolated combat poses but does not provide a reliable one-frame-per-angle contract or a verified common grip pivot. Do not continuously rotate these raster poses. Wardrobe displays them for visual audit until a future authored manifest supplies semantic aim sectors and attachment pivots.
